description: Read status, available results or a typed failure for an existing video search. Pass its canonical jobId and workspaceId. Read-only; no collection or charge. Poll this action instead of starting the search again. A completed result has videos[] (one normalised row per video on every platform: id, rank, thumbnailUrl, creator handle and followers, postedAt, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, viewsPerDay, engagementRate with its formula, and vsCreatorMedian, which has a ratio only when views are at least 3× the creator's median over at least 10 stored posts) and a summary (median views, top outliers, top views per day, date spread). Null values are unknown; videos[].unknown says why. If videos is null, videosUnavailable says why and the raw result is still complete. Results carry coverage, provider limitations and evidenceNotes. Rows are videos surfaced for the selected queries at capture time, not search volume or total market demand. Region is the collection market, not verified viewer geography. Views, likes and saves are per-video engagement snapshots, not engagement attributable to the query.
